evals.prompt: Mole 的 clean 新增了一个容器缓存删除保护：先用 lsof 判断目录空闲，随后 du 计算大小，最后 safe_remove。请深入 review 这个改动，重点看 dry-run、真实删除、超时、SIGINT、路径被替换和统计是否一致。只报告问题和验证方案，不修改代码。
evals.expected_output: A deletion-lifecycle review that traces discovery through the final sink, treats unknown state as refusal, checks dry-run parity, cancellation, identity rebinding, and accounting, and proposes red-green tests.
expectations: Traces the complete mutation lifecycle rather than reviewing only the lsof helper
Requires live or unknown state to fail closed and signal statuses to stop later deletion
Checks parent and target identity again immediately before the sink
Checks dry-run and real candidate parity plus cleaned-byte accounting
Requires a pre-fix failing regression or source invariant

evals.prompt: 这个 Bats 用例单独跑会过，放进 scripts/test.sh 偶尔失败。它断言某个缓存目录不存在，文件里 setup_file 共用 HOME，生产代码通过 command substitution 调 xcrun。帮我判断测试还是产品有问题，并给出可靠修法。
evals.expected_output: A test-validity diagnosis that checks shared HOME contamination, command-substitution subshell state, PATH versus function mocks, and CI-equivalent Bats execution before changing production code.
expectations: Treats shared setup_file HOME as the first isolation suspect
Explains that mutable shell counters do not persist through command substitution
Uses a test-owned file for cross-subshell call state when needed
Distinguishes PATH executable stubs from shell-function mocks
Preserves scripts/test.sh or --no-parallelize-within-files semantics

evals.prompt: 请帮 Mole 的 README 调整一段发布文案，并整理下一版 release notes，代码没有变化。
evals.expected_output: The bugs skill should decline this unrelated documentation and release-copy task and route it to the normal writing or release workflow.
expectations: Does not apply the bug catalog as a generic checklist
Recognizes that documentation and release copy are outside this skill

evals.prompt: Mole purge 的自动发现把 ~/node_modules 当成一个项目容器，然后从里面每个带 package.json 的包继续向下找 dist 和 build。请判断这里真正的安全边界，并给出不会误删依赖树的回归测试。
evals.expected_output: A purge-discovery diagnosis that makes mutation targets and automatic discovery containers disjoint, covers every target basename rather than only node_modules, preserves explicit configured roots as the escape hatch, and proves the pre-fix nested-artifact failure.
expectations: Explains why starting below the real artifact prevents nested-target collapsing
Rejects every purge target basename as an automatic discovery container instead of adding a node_modules-only special case
Keeps explicit user-configured purge roots as a separate trust contract
Builds a package-shaped fixture whose internal artifact is offered before the fix

evals.prompt: VS Code 的 .obsolete 是空的，但磁盘还有很多旧扩展。有人建议把所有 profile 的 extensions.json 合成 keep-set，编辑器没运行时删除不在集合里的目录。请深入判断是否安全，重点看 owner 语义、并发和最终删除证据。
evals.expected_output: A product-boundary and deletion-authority review that distinguishes a removal journal from an authoritative inventory, rejects an inferred keep-set without an owner lock or generation contract, and narrows cleanup to exact owner-authored markers or owner-supported GC.
expectations: Distinguishes journal, registry, cache, and authoritative inventory semantics
Explains that a stopped-process probe is not an owner lock or atomic snapshot
Checks for profiles or owner references appearing between scan and sink
Prefers exact owner-authored removal markers, owner GC, or no cleanup over inferred deletion

evals.prompt: clean 的第一个 live-cache 安全探测返回 124，但 helper 把它当 best-effort skip 返回 0；这个 helper 又跑在后台 timeout worker 里，父进程随后继续 Office 和后面的 clean section。帮我找完整修复面和有效测试。
evals.expected_output: A sticky-cancellation review that propagates 124 and signal statuses through candidate loops, helper returns, worker boundaries, parent orchestration, peer reaping, dry-run registration, and later sections, with a non-vacuous downstream-positive-control test.
expectations: Treats 124 and signal-derived statuses as cancellation of the whole destructive command
Explains why an exported worker variable does not mutate the parent shell
Stops and reaps peer workers and prevents Office or later sections from starting
Makes the later candidate otherwise succeed and proves its probe or sink is never reached
Checks dry-run preview registration as well as the real sink

evals.prompt: Analyze 连续触发两次异步 Time Machine probe，旧结果最后才回来；同时 Status 的本次进程采集失败，但手里有上一轮 zombie 和 top-process 数据。请设计不会显示假新鲜数据的状态契约和测试。
evals.expected_output: An async state design that rejects obsolete generations, tests refresh and navigation races, preserves the last complete process sample atomically on transient failure, and exposes original timestamp, stale, completeness, measured-zero, and unmeasured distinctions.
expectations: Carries a generation or probe ID through each async result and rejects obsolete results
Tests refresh, leave, return, and out-of-order completion rather than only the happy path
Keeps process values, collection time, stale marker, and completeness as one atomic sample
Returns the refresh error while preserving the last successful sample as stale
Distinguishes stale data, measured zero, and never measured in JSON or rendering

evals.prompt: Mole 的 release workflow 会从 mole 读 VERSION、改 Homebrew formula，再 force-with-lease 推送 mole-<version> 分支。请 review tag 不匹配、formula 出现 0/2 个 source 字段、远端分支已存在和检查后被并发创建的情况。只看发布门禁安全，不写 release notes。
evals.expected_output: A publication-gate review that enforces exact non-empty source/tag equality, exactly one source URL and paired checksum, refusal on an occupied branch, and an expected-absence force-with-lease that closes the precheck-to-push race.
expectations: Requires the triggering tag to equal V plus one non-empty source version exactly
Rejects zero or multiple top-level source URL and checksum matches without counting bottle checksums
Refuses to overwrite an existing release branch and gives an actionable next step
Uses an expected-absence ref lease to close the branch-creation race
Requires executable falsification fixtures in addition to source-text invariants
